// Fixed types for task (g). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ListenerError, ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** The pricing owner's own slice of the settings. */
export type PricingSettings = { readonly currency: string; readonly region: string };
/** What the pricing owner publishes to its children. */
export type PricingContext = { readonly currency: string; readonly vatRate: number; readonly discountPercent: number };
export declare function vatRateFor(region: string): number;
/** The percent a discount code is worth, or `undefined` for an unknown code. */
export declare function discountFor(code: string): number | undefined;
/** The gross total every module must use: net with VAT, minus the discount, rounded to cents. */
export declare function grossTotal(net: number, vatRate: number, discountPercent: number): number;

/** The Host's error sink for subscriber failures. */
export type ErrorsPort = { readonly report: (report: ListenerError) => undefined };
/** The command port the child uses to ask the owner for a change. */
export type DiscountRequests = { readonly requestDiscount: (code: string) => "accepted" | "rejected" };

// Parent: the pricing owner.
export type PricingOwnerDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<PricingSettings>; readonly errors: ErrorsPort };
export type PricingOwnerProduct = {
  readonly instance: undefined;
  readonly capabilities: {
    readonly "acme/pricing/context": ReadonlyStore<PricingContext>;
    readonly "acme/pricing/discounts": DiscountRequests;
  };
};

// Child: the checkout. It depends only on the part of the context it uses.
export type TotalDisplay = { readonly show: (total: number) => void };
export declare function createTotalDisplay(): TotalDisplay;
export type CheckoutDeps = {
  readonly pricing: ReadonlyStore<Pick<PricingContext, "vatRate" | "discountPercent">>;
  readonly discounts: DiscountRequests;
};
export type CheckoutPort = {
  readonly setNet: (net: number) => undefined;
  readonly applyCode: (code: string) => "accepted" | "rejected";
};
export type CheckoutProduct = { readonly instance: TotalDisplay; readonly capabilities: { readonly "acme/checkout": CheckoutPort } };
